name: Ironforge
summary: Beneath Dun Morogh, Ironforge’s Great Forge still burns at the heart of dwarven rule and Alliance trade. Deep within Ironforge Mountain, the city anchors Khaz Modan and guards the Alliance.

sections.title: The Mountain Fortress
sections.body:
Ironforge fills the deep halls of Ironforge Mountain, with stone rings circling the Great Forge. Dwarves founded the city millennia ago, after awakening and migrating from Uldaman. It has endured ages of history, including the War of the Three Hammers, which left the Bronzebeard clan in sole control.

Natural magma pours through the mountain and powers the city. Massive stone gates guard its halls. Dwarven craftsmen and warriors share them with many exiled gnomes, who arrived after Gnomeregan fell recently.

sections.title: Heart of Alliance Trade
sections.body:
Ironforge is one of the Alliance’s busiest centers of commerce and industry. From the High Seat, King Magni Bronzebeard rules Khaz Modan. Dwarven prospectors, miners, and engineers work beside gnome refugees in Tinker Town.

Beneath the mountains, the Deeprun Tram runs to Stormwind City. It carries trade and troops at high speed, keeping the capitals linked in mutual defense.

aliases: who is the king of ironforge
faq.answer: King Magni Bronzebeard rules Ironforge from the High Seat. The city is Khaz Modan’s seat, under the sole leadership of the Bronzebeard clan.

faq.q: Why are there so many gnomes living in Ironforge?
faq.answer: After Gnomeregan fell, the surviving gnomes fled to Ironforge. The Bronzebeards welcomed their longtime allies and gave them sanctuary in Tinker Town.

faq.q: How does Ironforge connect to Stormwind City?
faq.answer: The Deeprun Tram connects Ironforge directly to Stormwind. Built by gnomes, it runs underground from Tinker Town to Stormwind’s Dwarven District.

faq.q: What is the Great Forge in the center of the city?
faq.answer: The Great Forge is an immense furnace fueled by natural rivers of magma channeled through the heart of the mountain. It is Khaz Modan’s main center for smithing and smelting.

angles.text: As a dwarf, Ironforge is your ancestral capital and the heart of the Bronzebeard clan. Dwarven craft, valor, and history are carved into the living mountain stone.
As a gnome, you have lost Gnomeregan to troggs and radiation. Your people have made Tinker Town a temporary refuge and a staging ground for reclaiming your home.
